description: Window / table-calc TRANSLATION. A dataset-level CreateColumnsOperation (runningSum) and an analysis-level CalculatedField (percentOfTotal) both use window functions, which silently error in Sigma DM calc columns — so they are lowered to kind:'sql' helper elements with explicit SQL OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...) clauses (mirrors the Tableau table-calc path). Verifies the helper elements POST cleanly with zero error columns (the OVER columns resolve to real warehouse values, not Null). Partition/order are extracted from the QS expression args; the base aggregation grain comes from the visual grouping dims when available. Calcs whose partition/order can't be determined still degrade to Null (translate-where-determinable, degrade-where-not).
